text:
tess-marketing: Quick thread 3 we need a fresh battlecard for the 'launch social + webinar' pack vs cloud AI vendors. Priorities: 1) short social soundbites, 2) 1-slide bench callout, 3) SDR routing triggers. Keep it punchy.
raj-prod: Emphasize predictable pricing and graceful degradation. Avoid 'we are cheaper' absolutes. Suggest one-liner: "Predictable inference economics at production scale".
ana-growth: For social test: Variant A: 'Ship faster, pay less per useful token' Variant B: 'Enterprise inference without the ops overhead' 3 which is clearer for LinkedIn?
cam-sdr: SDRs need 3 quick rebut tags: pricing, hosting, latency. Example quick reply: "List price varies; our batching+cache lowers unit spend in production."
leo-eng: Bench snapshot ready. Small reproducible call for the slide: 
```
POST /bench/run
{ "model": "rwd-pro", "tokens": 1024 }
```
bench-bot: bench #901 completed 3 median 72ms, p95 130ms, p99 240ms (seq=1024).
tess-marketing: Nice. On wording: avoid technical jargon on social, but keep one technical note in the slide for reps. Raj please confirm fallback verbiage 3 legal-safe.
raj-prod: Use: "Automatic fallback to compatible model variants to maintain SLOs". Legal ok with that phrasing. No 'always' or 'zero' claims.
nana-growth: I'm leaning to Variant B for webinar hero. It's clear and ties to ops pain. For LinkedIn we can test both headlines + small bench stat.
cam-sdr: Routing rule proposal: if a prospect triggers 2+ bench objections or requests a deep-dive, auto-tag enterprise and route to Cam's queue. Also flag any mention of "self-hosted" + "SLA".
leo-eng: I'll attach p95/p99 PNGs and a one-line explainer about batching + KV caching impact.
tess-marketing: Action list: Raj finalize legal-safe one-liners; Leo export PNGs and attach bench snippet; Ana run two social variations; Cam finalize routing tags and quick rebut scripts (<=2 lines each). I'll compile battlecard PDF. :rocket:
cam-sdr: Will do. Quick draft rebut for 'we already host': "Great 3 we help you avoid build and ops cycles while giving predictable tail latency across regions."
bench-bot: quick note: bench config stored at /bench/configs/launch-2026.json
tess-marketing: Thanks team. Circling Monday for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
